terms.definition: Unified artboard/page/export region depending on context.
Design surface for vector/layout composition; a Surface in artboard context.
ContainerRole in the single document tree; Layers panel role, not a parallel hierarchy.
Non-destructive clipping/alpha control; source pixels preserved.
Reusable layout/content definition; V1 replacement for Master Pages.
Non-destructive, maskable, reorderable raster/color correction node.
Design or Photo tool/panel/action composition over one shared document.
Named mixed-workspace composition referencing semantic IDs.
Named reusable color definition in the semantic color system.
Link between a document property and a variable-data field.
Single row of a variable-data DataSource used in Data Merge generation.
Stable semantic identifier for a user operation (aubrieta.* namespace).
Semantic identifier for localizable UI copy; no literal strings in features.
Toolkit-independent namespaced icon identifier; domain never references icon names.
Canonical native file extension and open ZIP package format.
Short compatible alias of the same native format and schema.
Canonical application name for the Design + Photo desktop app.
Rejected: collides with the Fedora/RHEL ABRT ecosystem. Use .aubrieta/.aubri.
Rejected native extension candidate. Use .aubrieta/.aubri.
Out of scope for V1; use Symbols + SurfaceTemplate instead.
Lightweight reusable surface layout built on Symbols; V1 replacement for Master Pages.
